slides.title: Food trucks: when the holiday market asks for your permit and COI by Friday, say exactly this:

slides.label: Say this
slides.title: "Sending both today. Who should be named on the certificate?"
slides.body: Organizers often want to be listed on it. Ask now, not at load-in.

slides.label: Then do this
slides.title: Open the health permit and the policy and actually read the dates.
slides.body: "Pretty sure it's current" is not a date.

slides.label: If the COI lapsed
slides.title: "Our renewal is in process. I'll send the new certificate the day it's issued."
slides.body: Only say it after you've called your agent. Tonight.

slides.label: Then, this weekend
slides.title: Write down when your health permit, fire inspection, business license and insurance renew.
slides.body: All four. One list. Not the back of a ticket pad.

slides.label: Save this
slides.title: For the next 9 PM "quick question" email from an event organizer.
